revision_note: Work packages K01-K09 from PRD v0.2 section 11.3. K01 has its first implemented increment (aarch64 NEON fused packed dot for Q8_0/F16 + zero-copy mapped weight blocks, validated against scalar references and the llama.cpp envelope); the remaining packages are specified. A kernel must never be selected before its correctness gate passes; every selection retains a validated reference fallback decision. This is a CPU kernel increment; the Metal kernel path remains unbuilt.

kernels.name: Q8/Q4 packed matrix-vector decode
gates: exact format/scale decoding
bounded tiles, no full dequantized matrix
per-operation error checks registered before tuning

kernels.name: Shape-specific prompt matrix multiplication
gates: same projection semantics as reference
microbatch size recorded in plan
no unbounded prompt workspace

kernels.name: RMSNorm, activation and residual fusion
gates: epsilon, operation dependencies and rounding profile preserved
no approximate activation substitution

kernels.name: Ternary PQ2_0 / PTQ1_0 projection and embedding kernels
gates: native code and scale handling
group alignment and transform metadata enforced
malformed trits rejected

kernels.name: Hadamard/sign transforms and safe fusion

whole rotation block processed

kernels.name: Capability-compatible arithmetic (BF16/F16/F32)

software BF16 conversion where hardware lacks it
no silent FP16 substitute

kernels.name: Hybrid linear-attention/state kernels
gates: recurrent precision and update order preserved
full prefill, chunked prefill and decode consistency proven
state rollback machinery before any speculation

kernels.name: Attention/KV and MoE dispatch

bounded state and dispatch lifetime
